presentation.text:
I'm a second year full stack web developer student, based in Orleans France.
 I attend a university based in the city center called Coda. I always strive to get better with the tools I have but also want to learn about new things and constantly improve and become more and more polyvalent.
 Also looking for a internship to help me achieve my goals of progressing and gaining experience in tech, I look forward to working or talking with you.

about.about_me:
I'm a second year student at Coda school, I live and study in France but I would enjoy working and living abroad depending on the opportunity.
 I already speak English and French fluently and am working towards improving my Tagalog I'm a big fan of traveling and learning about different cultures as well.
 My hobbies include, programming notably backend development, microcontrollers, painting, 3d modelling, arachnology(Chromatopelma cyaneopubescens my beloved) and traveling.

project.text: Here are a few of the projects I have worked on over the course of the past year:

notSpot.title: NotSpot
notSpot.description:
Online and downloadable streaming service app, relying on community input to grow its musical selection.
Made as a project for my first year final exam and used to validate my first year.

terminalPortfolio.title: Terminal portfolio
terminalPortfolio.description:
My first portfolio made with JS to resemble and function like a terminal to dispense information about me.
Made while learning JavaScript and used to learn more about animations and handling user inputs.
Also contains easter eggs, my first deployed website using Render and Docker.

suggestibility.title: Suggestibility study application
suggestibility.description:
App commissioned by a psychologist to set up tests to evaluate suggestibility in children.
Made with a group of 4 other people and delivered in time.
 And respecting all the constraints imposed by the client,
 and imposed by the law regarding confidential information on patients.
Also made portable to distribute and modulable,
 enabling the user to change the test questions or contents to suit their needs.

codBlast.title: Cod'Blast
codBlast.description: GameJam project submitted as a Javascript final exam. Made with a group of 2 other people, made to play like BlockBlast, deployed on github pages.

email.title: Email sender CLI
email.description:
CLI made to send out emails in mass to user registered to a database.
 Made entirely in C for speed and used to send updates for NotSpot updates
